'''Armoured zombies''' are [[undead]] monsters that are encountered during the [[Defender of Varrock]], [[The Curse of Arrav]], [[Ritual of the Mahjarrat]], [[The World Wakes]], [[Dishonour among Thieves]], [[Dimension of Disaster]] and [[New Foundations]] quests and other locations, see below. The attack style of the zombie can be identified by the colour of the crest on its helmet. Armoured zombies with yellow crests on their helmets use [[Melee]], and those with blue crests use [[Ranged]]. Some of these wield [[scimitar]]s and the others wield [[throwing axes]].

==Locations==
* Since [[1 February]] [[2011]], armoured zombies can no longer be reached by going through the [[Wilderness]]. Instead, one must get [[Hartwin]] to teleport them to a safe version of the Wilderness, where armoured zombies can be fought by going down the trapdoor to the [[Chaos Temple Dungeon]].
* Armoured zombies are encountered in [[Varrock]] during the [[Defender of Varrock]] quest, but these only give 10 experience per kill and have no drops. They do leave behind a "red mist". During the [[Defender of Varrock]] quest, this "red mist" must be captured in [[bottle]]s, making a [[bottle of mist]], used to open doors further into the dungeon, and after this quest they have no use.
* There is one {{Maplink|title=Armoured zombie|desc=NPC ID: 14339|x=2844|y=3843|text=Armoured zombie|mtype=pin}} outside of [[Zemouregal's fort]] in [[The North]], but this does not have the usual drops.
* [[Sharathteerk]] summons armoured zombies to aid him during [[Ritual of the Mahjarrat]].
* [[Zemouregal]] summons armoured zombies to aid him during [[The World Wakes]].
* Armoured zombies are encountered underneath Zemouregal's fort during [[Dimension of Disaster]]
* Armoured zombies can be found on the {{floornumber|2}} of [[New Varrock]] palace in Dimension of Disaster, these drop red mist like the ones in Defender of Varrock. This mist can be gathered in regular vials however.
* Armoured zombies may be summoned by the Necromancers in [[The Shadow Reef]].

==Strategies==
As armoured zombies are classed as undead creatures, a [[salve amulet (e)]] is useful for fighting them. The amulet can also be used alongside a [[full slayer helmet]] or its components. Another option is wearing the [[demon horn necklace]] with the [[bonecrusher]] added to [[tool belt]] for infinite [[Prayer|Prayer points]].

Due to the convenience of an altar above the location of armoured zombies, combat-boosting prayers such as [[Turmoil]] may be used to increase the experience yield.

For maximum profit per hour when killing these zombies, players should pick up most of the stackable/noted drops, which include [[charm]]s, types of [[plank]]s, [[pure essence]] and [[blood rune]]s, but not [[eyes of newt]].
[[File:Armoured zombies training.png|thumb|right|290px|A player training on Armoured zombies]]
